about_item: Exceptional Sound Quality ：Equipped with 16.1mm vibrating diaphragm drivers, these Bluetooth earbuds deliver powerful bass, crisp mids, and clear treble for a rich, immersive sound experience. The built-in microphones isolate your voice for crystal-clear call quality, ensuring your conversations are always loud and clear, no matter where you are

Impressive 60H Total Playtime：Enjoy up to 12 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge, with the included charging case offering an additional 48 hours of battery life. That’s a total of 60 hours of music, calls, and more!

Over-Ear Design for Unmatched Comfort：kurdene over-ear headphones feature a unique design that rests gently and securely on top of your ears, ensuring a natural, pressure-free listening experience. The soft silicone ear hooks provide a snug and stable fit, making them perfect for all activities—from workouts to everyday wear

Bluetooth 5.4 – Stable Connection：Upgrade to the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology for faster data transfer and an ultra-stable connection. With a reliable range of up to 33 feet, you can enjoy seamless audio and video sync, making them perfect for gaming, movies, and music.

Intuitive Smart Touch Control：Control your music, manage calls, and activate voice assistants effortlessly with easy-to-use touch controls. With separate multifunction and volume buttons on each earbud, you can adjust volume, skip tracks, and answer calls—all without reaching for your phone

The sound quality is positive, and customers consider them good value for money. The battery life receives mixed feedback - while some say it lasts a long time, others report issues with charging. Durability is also mixed, with some saying they hold up well while others report them stopping working after 33 days.
